# Tidewell Hydration — Brand Narrative (synthetic fixture)

> Synthetic QA fixture for the MixShift plugin harness. Tidewell Hydration is
> an invented Seller Central drinkware brand. No real brand or account.

## Brand Identity

Tidewell Hydration is a mid-premium drinkware brand built around all-day
hydration: insulated flasks, sport bottles, glass bottles, and tumblers. The
positioning is "outdoor-ready, office-friendly" — vacuum insulation that holds
temperature for a full workday or a full hike. The catalog splits into three
sub-brands: Tidewell Flasks (insulated, the hero line), Tidewell Bottles
(sport and glass), and Tidewell Tumblers (desk and travel).

The account runs on Seller Central (3P), US marketplace only, and is managed to
an ACOS efficiency target. The brand cares about ad-only efficiency first;
total-sales efficiency (TACOS) is watched as a secondary guardrail and surfaced
in skill bottom lines, but it does not drive bid decisions.

## Customer Language Samples

How shoppers describe Tidewell products in reviews, Q&A, and search:

- "Keeps my water cold from morning drop-off until I pick the kids up."
- "The flask survived a 12-mile hike and didn't dent."
- "Lid doesn't leak in my gym bag — finally."
- "Wide mouth fits ice cubes, narrow enough to fit a cup holder."
- "Bought the tumbler for my desk, the bottle for the trail."

Recurring positive themes: temperature retention, leak-proof lids, durability,
cup-holder fit. Recurring complaints: paint chipping on the matte finish, the
straw lid sold separately, weight of the larger sizes.

## Current Quarter Context

Q2 2026 is a launch-plus-event quarter. Glass-bottle SKUs launched in April and
are still inside their learning period — ACOS runs hot there and campaigns are
protected from aggressive pullbacks through end of Q2. A Prime Day media push
(July 8-12) is concentrated on the flask line and will temporarily inflate
flask-group ACOS; that spike is planned, not a bid-management failure.

Posture is efficiency with a 0.5 bid-cut multiplier: the account leans toward
tightening rather than scaling, except where a structural event protects a lane.

## Historical Notes

- Brand entered Amazon in 2023 with the flask line; bottles and tumblers were
  added across 2024-2025.
- Settlement capture rate has been stable around 60-65% at T-1, settling by T-14;
  fresh-day ACOS improves roughly 4-5 points once attribution lands.
- Competitor set (Hydrowave, PeakFlask, SummitSip) occasionally collides with
  Tidewell brand-misspelling terms; competitor_brands is set so negation skills
  don't false-positive on those.
- No stockouts of note in the trailing two quarters; the matte-finish paint-chip
  complaint is a known PDP theme, not an operational event.
